system.description:
Olganyar Inheritance: a business. Very Rare, Rot. No item slots.

This small, cursed tavern serves fish and a few select imported drinks. Unfortunately, it’s deeply haunted.

Work the Bar (Ceremony): As a Long Rest Action, you can work on your Tavern. Choose one of the following:
Open the Bar: You open the tavern for business. Make 100gp. Then, increase the Spirit Counter by +2. Then, roll 1D20. If you roll a 19 or higher, the spirits attack, murdering 1D6 patrons. For each patron murdered, pay 300gp to the victim’s family. If you cannot pay, your GM decides if you narratively owe a blood debt, or if mechanically you receive a Bane Token. Reduce the Spirit Counter by 3 for each Patron murdered after this.
Renovate Bar: You renovate the bar. Increase the money permanently made by the bar per long rest action (forever) by 10% (max: 500gp). Also, increase the Spirit Counter by +1. Do not roll.
Placate Spirits: (Prerequisite: 100gp of Offerings). Expend 200gp worth of offerings. Reset the Spirit Counter to 0.

Spirit Counters (Passive): The Red Herring Tavern tracks spirit counters, denoting how angry the spirits are. At the start, this number is 0. It has no upper limit, but may affect your rolls.

Rulebook p.54.

business.note: Open the Bar: the Spirit Counter rises by 2, and on a 19+ on 1D20 the spirits attack.
